_readme: Copy-paste library of ReAct Agent v2 tool definitions — one per node type in the registry. Drop any of these objects into the 'tools' inputParameter of an 'Autonomous ReAct Agent v2' node. Every 'config' key below matches the real input key that node reads in app/nodes/*.py.

tools.name: Search Products
tools.description: Search the catalogue by keywords. Returns up to 5 products with id, title, price, rating and stock.

tools._pattern: REST POST — JSON body, mixed LLM + engine values
tools.name: Add To Cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopper's cart. You must know the numeric product id first.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units to add. Use 1 by default.

tools._pattern: Vector knowledge base — the query is the only LLM-controlled field
tools.name: Search Knowledge Base
tools.description: Search the internal knowledge base for how-tos, policies and known fixes. Use this before answering any 'how do I' question.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: What to look for, in plain words.

tools._pattern: Web search — note the real keys are search_query / search_count
tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Search the public internet. Use only when the knowledge base has nothing and the topic is public.

tools._pattern: Database read — Mongo find with an LLM-supplied filter value
tools.name: Lookup Asset
tools.description: Look up the hardware assigned to an employee (model, asset tag, warranty end) from the CMDB.

parameters.name: employee_email
parameters.description: Email of the employee whose asset you need.

tools._pattern: Database write — Mongo insert with a whole object from the LLM
tools.name: Log Feedback
tools.description: Store the shopper's feedback so the team can review it. Use when the user complains or praises something.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: The feedback in the shopper's own words.

tools._pattern: Natural-language SQL — hand the sub-question to another engine
tools.name: Ask Sales Database
tools.description: Answer questions about orders, revenue and customers by querying the sales SQL database in plain English.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: A single, self-contained question about the sales data.
parameters.example: total revenue for October 2025 by region

tools._pattern: Side effect — email, with a confirmation-first description
tools.name: Email Summary
tools.description: Send an email to the user. Only call this after the user has explicitly asked you to email something.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Full email body in plain text.

tools._pattern: Classifier as a tool — fixed label set
tools.name: Classify Intent
tools.description: Classify a customer message into one of the supported intents. Use it when you are unsure which workflow applies.

config.instructions: Pick the single best matching intent.

tools._pattern: Entity extraction — schema fixed, text from the LLM
tools.name: Extract Entities
tools.description: Pull structured entities (product, brand, budget) out of a sentence.

tools._pattern: Another whole flow as one tool (sub-agent)
tools.name: Run Refund Workflow
tools.description: Run the full refund workflow for an order. Use only when the customer explicitly asks for a refund.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why the customer wants a refund.

tools._pattern: A second LLM as a tool — user_message_key points at a tool argument
tools.name: Summarise Text
tools.description: Summarise a long piece of text into three bullet points.

config.Prompt: Summarise the user's text into exactly three short bullet points.

tools._pattern: Zero-argument tool — everything comes from flow state
tools.name: View Cart
tools.description: Show the shopper's current cart and totals. Takes no arguments.

tools._pattern: Auto-inferred arguments — no 'parameters' block at all
tools.name: Get Ticket Status
tools.description: Fetch the live status of a helpdesk ticket by its id.

tools._pattern: MCP tool — schema comes from the remote server, never declare parameters
tools.name: Jira Search
